regions.name: Portugal

record_end.rule: a file's final month counts if it has a detection in that month's last 3 days; a VIIRS satellite with 0 detections in a month while the other has >= 20 does not cover that month
record_end.after: 2026 to the present needs NASA's FIRMS near-real-time API key (pending)

regions.model: A2 + NOAA-20 via Suomi NPP (round-2 choice, frozen)

model_detail.name: A2 + NOAA-20 via Suomi NPP (round-2 choice, frozen)

noaa20.method: J-S: x s (NOAA-20 to Suomi NPP), then A2

model_detail.method: A2: per 0.25 deg cell x calendar month x day/night, posterior MODIS per Suomi NPP detection (a + sum MODIS) / (a / r0 + sum VIIRS) over rows with Suomi NPP > 0; b = mean MODIS where it saw nothing. NOAA-20: x s, then A2 (pipeline/round2/models.py)
model_detail.interval: A2's predictive per cell-month (negative binomial for V > 0, Poisson(b) for V = 0) plus Var(s) for NOAA-20, day + night added, satellites averaged; 10th/90th percentile of the moment-matched negative binomial (approximate)

combination.rule: in each region x calendar month x day/night slot, a satellite enters the average only if model A's prior ratio r0 > 0 there; one qualifying satellite carries the slot alone; none qualifying keeps A's literal behaviour (weight 0, background as fitted). Decided 31 Oct 2026 after observing NOAA-20's short 21-month fit window. Model A itself is unchanged.

provenance.filters: box lon -9.6..-6.1, lat 36.9..42.2; vegetation fires only (type 0); MODIS confidence >= 30; VIIRS confidence nominal or high
provenance.unit: fire detections (satellite pixels flagged as burning), not burned area

burning_days.unit: MODIS-equivalent burning days: how many days each 0.01 degree cell (about 1 km) had a fire detected
burning_days.definition: a 0.01 degree cell (floor(lon / 0.01), floor(lat / 0.01)) counts once per date and day/night if it has any detection of the family (MODIS = Terra + Aqua; Suomi NPP; NOAA-20); it takes the FRP class of its largest-FRP detection (f0 FRP <= 0, f1 0 < FRP < 5, f2 5 <= FRP < 20, f3 FRP >= 20 MW)
burning_days.model: D-a + NOAA-20 via Suomi NPP (burning days, round-3 confirmed)

model_detail.name: D-a + NOAA-20 via Suomi NPP (burning days, round-3 confirmed)
model_detail.classes: f0 FRP <= 0, f1 0 < FRP < 5, f2 5 <= FRP < 20, f3 FRP >= 20 MW

snpp.method: D-a (C3 in burning days): one A2-style ratio per FRP class

noaa20.method: J-S: x s (NOAA-20 to Suomi NPP, in burning days), then D-a

model_detail.method: D-a: per 0.25 deg cell x calendar month x day/night x FRP class, posterior MODIS burning days per Suomi NPP burning day (a + sum MODIS_k) / (a / r0_k + sum VIIRS_k) over rows with Suomi NPP > 0, MODIS split over classes at the fitted fixed point; b = mean MODIS burning days where Suomi NPP saw nothing. NOAA-20: x s, then D-a (pipeline/round3/model.py, pipeline/tournament/candidates.py)
model_detail.interval: D-a's predictive per cell-month (class negative binomials summed and moment-matched for V > 0, Poisson(b) for V = 0) plus Var(s) for NOAA-20, day + night added, satellites averaged; 10th/90th percentile of the moment-matched negative binomial (approximate)

combination.rule: as the hotspot view: a satellite enters a slot's average only if some FRP class has a prior ratio r0_k > 0 there (and s > 0 for NOAA-20); one qualifying satellite carries the slot alone; none qualifying keeps D-a's literal behaviour (weight 0, background as fitted)
